articles.executive_summary: Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Cursor Data Breach and Trojanized Claude Code Extension. The compromise of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace was the result of the theft of an access key that was exposed in the wake of a breach targeting Fireworks AI.

Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.
